subject: Request: Temporary Tertiary Responder Activation for LaunchCo 72h Traffic Surge
messages:
From: Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@launchco.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@launchco.com>, procurement@launchco.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary Tertiary Responder Activation for LaunchCo 72h Traffic Surge

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well — LaunchCo is planning a staged public launch of a major integration next Friday that will drive a concentrated spike of inference traffic for approximately 72 hours starting 2026-09-25 00:00 UTC. Our SREs’ forecast shows bursts that will raise peak token QPS ~6x above baseline and could surface more P1/P2 incidents than our standard support window expects.

We’re requesting Redwood temporarily activate our tertiary responder path (third-tier on-call escalation) for the 72-hour window and amend the P1/P2 response commitments for that period: we want P1 guaranteed within 15 minutes and P2 within 2 hours (instead of the standard 30/4). We understand there is an operational cost and are prepared to discuss short-term credits or a one-time activation fee.

Attached: LaunchCo_tertiary_runbook_v2.pdf and a short traffic forecast (traffic-forecast-72h.csv). Please confirm availability, the escalation path (who will be the tertiary responder), and any DocuSign or amendment steps required to lock the change.

Thanks — this is critical for the launch.

— Maria
Maria Alvarez
Head of Integrations, LaunchCo
phone: +1 415 555 0199
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@launchco.com>, Jared Kim <jared.kim@launchco.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary Tertiary Responder Activation for LaunchCo 72h Traffic Surge

Thanks Maria — and cc’ing Ben, Evelyn and Chloe to scope operational overhead and quick cost/credit terms.

Quick asks we need to close in the next 48 hours:
- Can Ben confirm commercial approach (one-time activation fee vs credit) + suggested amount?
- Evelyn / Chloe: can you confirm who from infra/senior on-call (tertiary) will be assigned and what the on-call rotation looks like for the 72h window starting 2026-09-25 00:00 UTC? We need names, phone/skype, and expected response SLAs (we should be explicit: P1 15m, P2 2h).
- Maria / LaunchCo: final traffic slices? I saw the attached CSV but please call out any heavier-than-forecast windows.

Operational notes: we can activate a named tertiary responder pool and route LaunchCo incidents to it; during activation we’ll also enable an elevated alert threshold and a temporary canary fallback to a lower-cost model to preserve availability if GPU capacity is constrained. That said, we need an approved amendment (DocuSign) to the support terms to record the temporary SLA shift and acknowledge cost.

Ben — if you want, I can draft a short amendment language and Evelyn can validate runbook changes.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@launchco.com>, Jared Kim <jared.kim@launchco.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary Tertiary Responder Activation for LaunchCo 72h Traffic Surge

On Fri, Sep 18, 2026 at 8:45 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Maria — and cc’ing Ben, Evelyn and Chloe to scope operational overhead and quick cost/credit terms.

Thanks — I’ll own the commercial side. Proposal below:

Summary: Activate tertiary responder pool for LaunchCo for 2026-09-25 00:00 UTC through 2026-09-28 00:00 UTC (72h). Temporary SLA targets during activation: P1 response <= 15 minutes; P2 response <= 2 hours.
Commercials:
- One-time activation fee: $12,500 (covers dedicated paging, escalation overrides, priority capacity slices).
- Alternative: $10,000 credit billed against usage for customers preferring to offset token charges.
- If activation triggers additional Dedicated capacity (we’ll know after first 6 hours), we’ll estimate additional committed spend and notify LaunchCo before scaling.

Operational playbook (high level):
1) Pre-activation (by 2026-09-23): Evelyn to nominate tertiary responders (names + mobile).
2) Activation (2026-09-25 00:00 UTC): Apply routing policy that pins LaunchCo to the dedicated responder pool; raise alert priority; enable canary fallback model with preserved latency SLO.
3) During window: weekly cadence is overloaded — we’ll run twice-daily syncs if incidents > 3 in 12h.
4) Deactivation (2026-09-28 00:00 UTC): revert routing and finalize incident report.

Escalation path: responder -> senior infra on-call (Evelyn) -> Rishi Malhotra (VP Eng) -> Stephanie (CS lead) -> SVP Ops (exec escalation if SLA breach). We’ll add phone handoffs for 15-minute P1 commitment.

Action items for us today:
- Stephanie: draft amendment (short, timeboxed) and DocuSign template.
- Evelyn / Chloe: confirm responder list and on-call overlap windows.
- Maria: confirm acceptance of commercials and sign DocuSign link (I’ve created the draft template; link attached in docusign-activation-link.txt).

I’ll queue the amendment after Stephanie’s language.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@launchco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Kim <jared.kim@launchco.com>, procurement@launchco.com
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary Tertiary Responder Activation for LaunchCo 72h Traffic Surge

Thanks Ben and team — we accept the one-time activation fee ($12,500) and the proposed timeline. Please send the DocuSign amendment and the final responder roster. We’d like confirmation that the tertiary pool will have direct paging and will be reachable by phone for P1s.

Also, minor ask: if during the first 6 hours you determine we need extra Dedicated capacity, please pause scaling for 30 minutes and notify our SREs before any auto-scaling to confirm fallback model details.

Attachment: signed-scope-acknowledgement.pdf (stub).

Looking forward — Maria
